text:
Duluth Police Department rolls out new Transparency Hub
- Updated
The Duluth Police Department has built a Transparency Hub designed to make public data easier to access. It acts as a one-stop spot for public data, including complaints, crime maps, traffic stops, crash locations, and use-of-force reports. The Transparency Hub is available on the City of Duluth website, and on Friday, May 15, it will be released on the City of Duluth app.
